page_note: Page contains the tail of one heavily-damaged kephalaion on light/rays passing through firmaments (segs 0-12) and the opening of a new kephalaion on the three icons (pneumatic/psychic/somatic) in the human constitution (segs 16-34). The substrate is dominant: both teachings are correspondential — the first maps cosmic light-architecture (rays, firmaments, gates, channels), the second maps the triadic constitution of the human being (Mind of Light → New Man → Old Man → flesh). The editorial framing is light: a chapter title, a dialogue-frame opener at i=16 (seam flag confirms 'ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ'), and one institutional intrusion of 'elect' (ⲉⲕⲩⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ) at i=17 redirecting what was originally a teaching about the human as such. Heavy lacunae (~88.6% damage) limit certainty.
